description: This PHP file defines the class DashletMetaDataParser, which extends ListLayoutMetaDataParser. It manages the parsing and merging of metadata for dashlet views in the SuiteCRM module, including handling search and list view configurations, as well as saving dashlet definitions.

classes.name: DashletMetaDataParser
classes.description: A class for parsing, merging, and saving metadata configurations for dashlet views, supporting both search and list views within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with view type, module, and package info, setting up columns and view definitions accordingly.

methods.name: mergeFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Merges view and field definitions based on whether the parser is handling a search or dashlet view, including filtering relate fields.

methods.name: convertSearchToListDefs
methods.description: Converts search view definitions into list view definitions by ensuring each field has a 'name' key.

methods.name: ConvertSearchToDashletDefs
methods.description: Adjusts field definitions for dashlet views, especially default fields.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the dashboard or dashlet metadata file, including handling paths, file creation, and updating internal data structures.
